acceptanceCriteria: make spec-requirements regenerates or verifies the requirement range shown in each docs/specs/README.md row
a doc gate fails when a README row range disagrees with REQUIREMENTS.tsv
body:
Observed by the docs batch lane (2026-10-21, V1-1612): the PWR-V0 row in docs/specs/README.md still said an older requirement range after the spec grew to PWR-V0-045. `make spec-requirements` regenerates REQUIREMENTS.tsv and INDEX.json but not the README rows, so every spec growth needs a hand edit that no gate checks.
Expected: the README range column is generated or checked against REQUIREMENTS.tsv.

title: docs/specs/README.md spec rows are not generated by make spec-requirements, so ranges drift
